title: LEADERBOARD HEADS SIT OVER THEIR COLUMNS
why: Seen in the first 1080p picture of the run card leaderboard step: the small grey column heads (RANK, SCORE, OUTCOME, SECTOR, TIME, DATE) did not sit over their figures, because the head row was set in a smaller type and the grid columns are measured in that type, so they came out narrower than the rows under them and SCORE ended well to the left of the dollar figures. The heads are smaller on their own now and the row keeps the same column widths as the rows, so each head shares its edge with the column under it. Picture only, no number moved.
now: The leaderboard column heads now sit over their columns.

edits.replacement: '.lbp .lbh{color:#9a8f78;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(154,143,120,.35);margin-bottom:.15em}.lbp .lbh span{font-size:.8em}'+   /* v27.NN (cboard5): the column heads are smaller on their own, so the grid columns (in em of the row) stay the width the rows have and every head sits over its figures */
